mr-01: Morning remembrance of Hanuman of endless valor, bee at Rama’s lotus feet, delighter of gods by burning Lanka, abode of all success.
mr-02: Midday bow to the sole bridge over the ocean of sin, refuge, skilled dryer of Sita’s ocean of grief, imperishable Anjaneya, wish-tree of devotees.
mr-03: Evening worship of the compassionate one famed for destroying the mass of sorrows of those who take refuge, slayer of Aksha, comet to the rakshasa line, delighter of Janaki.
